reason: An SSH-based VPS management plugin that lets agents maintain server targets, test connections, execute remote commands, and transfer files, with an optional settings UI.

summaries.zh: 通过 SSH 管理云服务器目标，支持连接测试、远程命令执行、文件上传下载和可选的设置页面。
summaries.en: Manage cloud servers over SSH with connection testing, remote command execution, file transfer, and an optional settings page.

capabilities: Stores SSH server connection targets and references to local key files
Imports and manages SSH configuration entries
Executes shell commands on remote servers
Uploads and downloads files via SCP
Supports passwords, pasted private keys, ProxyJump, and ProxyCommand
Provides an optional settings-page user interface
